name: Build your AE2 network around a useful job

pages.text: AE2 is the pack’s main storage system. Follow its quests and use the GregTech processing recipes in JEI to prepare the required components.$(br2)Begin with a small network that stores and retrieves useful materials. Confirm power, connections and storage capacity before expanding into a much larger layout.
As the network grows, check the connection and channel requirements of the devices you add. A visible cable alone does not prove every device has a working connection.

Use an MV Mixer for Fluix Crystals. Prepare printed processors with a Laser Engraver and Skystone Lens, then finish processors in a Circuit Assembler. Follow JEI for the ingredients and processing fluids.

For a Quantum Network Bridge, prepare paired Quantum Entangled Singularities in an HV-capable Implosion Compressor. The recipe uses a Singularity and Ender Pearl Dust; JEI shows the quantities and machine requirements.
